name: Sutherland Global (Partner)
desc:
CSR, Temporary 6 month (Scholarship Program Support) | $15-$17/hr | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Sutherland Global
Industry: Business Process Outsourcing / Education & Scholarship Administration Support
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be answering inbound calls from families and schools participating in a scholarship program, helping them understand where things stand with an application, funding status, or general registration questions. A lot of the value here is being a patient, active listener, since families calling in are often anxious about whether their student's funding will come through. You'd need to actually solve problems rather than just direct people elsewhere, confirming details, clarifying next steps, and making sure the caller leaves the conversation with a real answer.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in this posting. Sutherland's broader postings typically require a High School Diploma or GED.
Required Experience: Experience in customer service required, no specific years stated.
Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out.
Required Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication; strong multitasking ability
Fluency in English
Drive to solve problems and meet goals
Familiarity with Microsoft Office tools
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone who wants short-term, real experience with a defined end date (6-month contract) rather than an open-ended commitment
Someone patient and empathetic, since callers may be stressed about a student's funding status
Someone comfortable with genuinely varied calls, from simple status checks to more involved application questions
Someone who already has some customer service background, even if not call-center specific
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who needs guaranteed long-term or permanent employment, since this is explicitly a temporary 6-month contract
Anyone who can't meet the hardwired internet requirement
Anyone who needs a confirmed pay number before applying; this posting doesn't list one
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Inbound call handling
Customer inquiry resolution
Multitasking under pressure
Application status support
Problem-solving and goal orientation
Microsoft Office proficiency
Verbal and written communication
Detail-oriented documentation
Empathetic customer service
Remote independent work
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Application → Assessment → Phone screen → Final interview. Total time to hire averages 3 to 15 days. Note: this is explicitly a temporary, 6-month contract position, not permanent.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your customer service experience and how you handle a caller who's anxious or stressed.
How do you stay organized when multitasking between listening, typing, and researching an answer?
Walk us through how you'd explain a scholarship funding status update to a worried parent.
What's your comfort level with a defined 6-month contract rather than an open-ended role?
How do you handle a question you don't immediately know the answer to?
